start_time.description: Timestamp marking the beginning of the blink event, expressed in the time units defined in the corresponding blink-signal metadata.

end_time.description: Timestamp marking the end of the blink event, expressed in the time units defined in the corresponding blink-signal metadata.

duration.description: Total duration of the blink event, measured as the difference between end_time and start_time.

eye_openness_left.description: Estimated openness of the left eye during the blink event, expressed in the units or scale defined in the corresponding blink-signal metadata.

eye_openness_right.description: Estimated openness of the right eye during the blink event, expressed in the units or scale defined in the corresponding blink-signal metadata.

confidence.description: Confidence score representing the reliability of the detected blink event, where 0 indicates lowest confidence and 1 indicates highest confidence.
